# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 5.3.x   | :white_check_mark: |
| < 5.3   | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a potential security vulnerability within Rectilinear Redundancies, please do not disclose it publicly in an open GitHub issue.

Instead, please report security concerns directly to the project maintainers via email at:
**`raunakpc23@gmail.com`**

Please include:
1. A description of the vulnerability and its potential impact.
2. Step-by-step instructions or proof-of-concept demonstrating how to reproduce it.
3. Suggested remediations, if available.

We will acknowledge receipt within 48 hours and work with you to remediate and publish a fix.
